notes: E.g.f. = C^2 exp(-xC^2) (re-derived); Bala's congruence a(n+k) = (-1)^k a(n) mod k from his 2017 Theorem 1 with y=-x; so a(n+p) = -a(n) mod p and the finite check a(0..p-1) mod p != 0 for p in {2,5,13,29,31,37,41,43,53,71,97} settles it. Outside Lean: everything (PARI certificate: e.g.f. to O(x^400), congruence for n+k<400, residues).
